## Class Assets

Client-scoped asynchronous resource loading on bounded engine workers. Ready models/images feed the normal renderer.

Script global: `assets`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `load(path: string, kind: string)` | `number` | Queue bytes, image, model or baked scene or PBR level import without blocking. Returns a client-owned request id; duplicate requests share a job. |
| `status(id: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Poll loading/ready/failed/cancelled status and error. This never waits for disk or decoding. |
| `cancel(id: number)` | `void` | Request cooperative cancellation of a loading asset. Late worker results cannot publish. |
| `release(id: number)` | `void` | Release a request and its CPU cache entry; cancel work if pending. Does not remove existing scene entities or GPU copies. |
| `stats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Inspect shared worker activity, bounded queue counts, CPU cache bytes and only this client's requests. |


## Class Audio

Scoped voice pool, streaming music and deterministic CPU mixing; classic channels share this output.

Script global: `audio`.

| Property | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sampleRate` | `number` | read | Mixer output frames per second. |
| `rendering` | `boolean` | read | A prepared or running audio frame awaits owner publication; playback queries retain the previous published state and controls require completion. |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `dopplerVoice(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Scoped desired Doppler target, last installed interpolation ratio/frames, effective user pitch/rate and captured world source/listener velocities with motion reset reasons. Frozen during final worker DSP. Spatial.doppler opts in; coordinates metres and velocities m/s. Direct radial model; no propagation delay or per-reflection Doppler. |
| `motionSettings(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Client automatic world-velocity inference settings: max_interval_ms=250,teleport_distance=50 metres. Explicit velocities bypass inference. Retained host policy, not a VM save. |
| `setMotionSettings(settings: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Set strict MotionSettings and reset this client's automatic source/listener histories. Pose capture happens once per App frame; DSP interpolation belongs to workers. |
| `resetMotion(—)` | `void` | Reset this client's automatic source/listener pose histories for the next frame, such as a teleport. Explicit velocities are retained. Does not reset source position, user pitch/rate or DSP history. |
| `beginSeekChannel(channel: number, source_frame: number)` | `number` | Begin a scoped seek on an existing native/media channel, without reopening its decoder or resetting fades/loop/pause. A retained ticket acknowledges actual cursor publication independently of later EOF. |
| `channelSeekStatus(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Retained AudioPreparation {channel,phase,error} for a channel seek. During a render-worker lease new completion remains pending until frame publication. Foreign/obsolete tickets fail. |
| `cancelChannelSeek(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel a pending channel seek and realign its previous logical cursor, or release a terminal receipt. A later seek is unaffected. Pending final DSP must be collected before cancellation. |
| `exchangeChannels(left: number, right: number)` | `void` | Atomically exchange this client's two shared native/media logical channels, moving a voice if the other side is empty. Retains source handle, fractional cursor, DSP history and gain/transport ramps; opens no decoder. Unpublished preparation intents, pending seeks/retirement actors or render leases reject before any change. Ready receipts remain historical observations of their earlier publication. This is separate from decoded left/right channel swap; pooled VoiceHandles remain unchanged. |
| `nativeChannelInfo(channel: number)` | `any` | Shared native/media channel AudioPlaybackInfo or null when ended. Scoped to the caller; source frame units, output-clock fades/delays and source completion remain distinct from processing tails. |
| `setChannelGainEnvelope(channel: number, envelope: any)` | `void` | Set a mixer-owned stepped dB100 envelope: interval_ms,steps,start_db100,end_db100, optional elapsed_steps/phase_ms/apply_initial/stop_at_end. The -10000 floor is silence. Output time advances through pause/starvation; null cancels at current gain. No decoder/source restart. |
| `channelGainEnvelope(channel: number)` | `any` | Published stepped gain spec, elapsed_steps, phase_ms, current_db100 and active, or null for an absent voice/track. Foreign client state is inaccessible. |
| `setVoiceGainEnvelope(handle: Record<string, any>, envelope: any)` | `void` | Apply the same stepped dB100 envelope to a scoped pooled voice. Null cancels it at the applied level; ordinary gain controls supersede this track. |
| `voiceGainEnvelope(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `any` | Published stepped gain state of a scoped pooled voice, or null without an envelope. |
| `beginVoiceRelease(spec: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Retire a shared native channel decoder to a tail channel without reopening or seeking; admit an externally clocked stepped db100 release and return an owned operation handle. Pending is not transfer completion. |

| `playbackInfo(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Exact shared AudioPlaybackInfo for a live pooled voice: decoded-source position/rate/length, publication age, running transport frames, paused/loop state and distinct stop/pause fade/resume-delay counters. |

Options policy:freeze (default) or preserve continues the prior input/pause fade until the deadline. reset_gain:true restarts a gain fade from zero to the latest target instead of fading transport; default false preserves an independent gain ramp. Later pause/stop/resume replaces it; EOF cancels it. Readiness is independent. |

Movement coalesces; fixed delay history is preserved and tap plans crossfade. Initial work holds the source clock, including HRTF dependency. clearVoiceReflections disables tracking. Playback options may include reflections to register before a short source runs. |

Pose/scene/latency changes invalidate these static snapshots; prepare again or opt into trackVoiceReflections. |

Static effects require re-preparation after pose changes; tracked effects coalesce updates and expose waiting/draining state. |

| `advanceCueSequence(handle: Record<string, any>, game_ms: number, real_ms: number)` | `void` | One owner-frame clock update, each delta 0..60000. Pending cue dependencies freeze time. Resets the 1024-emission frame budget. App does not advance these caller-owned clocks automatically. |

| `seekVoice(handle: Record<string, any>, frame: number)` | `void` | Synchronous exact seek. Worker-buffered streams require beginSeekVoice/seekVoiceAsync. |
| `fadeVoiceGain(handle: Record<string, any>, gain: number, fade_ms: number, stop_after: boolean \| null)` | `void` | Ramp own amplitude to a finite0..4 target and optionally stop when that ramp truly completes, without an extra fade to zero. | `finishVoiceGainFade(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Finish the current own-amplitude ramp at its retained target. A gain-stop retires the voice; independent transport stop deadlines are preserved. Foreign/stale handles fail. |
| `setVoiceLoop(handle: Record<string, any>, schedule: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Replace a live decoded-frame loop schedule {start,end?:frame,passes?:positiveCount}; omitted end uses source EOF and omitted passes loops unbounded. Count includes the current pass. Keeps the fractional source cursor and paused state; seek does not reset the count. Requires valid source range; changes apply on the next completed mixer boundary. |
| `setVoice(handle: Record<string, any>, options: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Update {gain? OR gain_db100?:-16000..1204,pan?:0..1,stereo_gain?:[left,right]0..4,swap_channels?:boolean,fade_ms?,rate?,pitch_semitones?,paused?,transport_active?,spatial?}. transport_active:false parks source/DSP while gain/pan clocks continue; full paused still freezes controls. Ended retained sources require a completed seek before activation. gain_db100 is finite hundredths of one dB; -10000 remains finite attenuation, use gain:0 for silence. Independent stereo_gain applies after pan/spatial DSP, before Master/reverb sends. Fade uses linear amplitude and rendered voice-frame clocks; paused/dependency-held voices retain ramps. Pitch/rate change resampling speed. |
| `voice(handle: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | {playing,source_playing,position_seconds?}; playing includes pending stop completion and effect tails; source_playing excludes both. Stale/stolen/ended handles are inactive. |

Partial settings: parent?:string\|null, gain?:0..4, muted?:boolean; new defaults parent=null,gain=1,muted=false. Parent must exist in both namespaces; cycles/depth>8/budgets fail atomically. Fade uses each output clock, including silence/paused sources. This is gain control, not an effect submix. |
| `mixGroup(name: string)` | `any` | Pooled AudioMixGroupInfo for the next output frame, or null. Controls multiply voice gain and ancestors before bus/master and reverb sends. Host controls persist through playback clear/restore; DSP history is not saved. |
| `nativeMixGroup(name: string)` | `any` | Native/media mixer AudioMixGroupInfo or null. Native adapters may define scoped groups independently of pooled voices. |
| `removeMixGroup(name: string)` | `void` | Remove from both namespaces after validating neither has child groups or live voice/effect instances. Unobserved playback resolves its logical group name again at publication. |
| `setVoiceMixGroup(handle: Record<string, any>, group: string \| null)` | `void` | Route a live pooled voice to an existing client group, or null to bypass groups; preserves source position and independent voice fades. |
| `setBus(bus: string, settings: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | master/music/sfx/voice/ambient/ui {gain:0..4,muted:boolean}. |
| `bus(bus: string)` | `Record<string, any>` | Read this client's bus settings. |
| `setDucking(config: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Dialogue-driven music ducking {gain,attack_ms,release_ms}. |
| `setVoiceLimit(limit: number)` | `void` | Set this client's pool limit within the host's global budget; stop voices before lowering below the active count. |
| `setSeed(seed: number)` | `void` | Reset this client's deterministic variant generator and repeat history. |
| `setListener(listener: any)` | `void` | {position,forward,up,velocity?}; explicit velocity is world m/s, otherwise App infers from pose. null restores the camera and resets listener history. |
| `stats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Mixer active/stolen/rejected voices, rendered frames, per-voice underrun frames and unclipped peak. |

Commands issued: `play` → `service.play_audio`, `stop` → `service.stop_audio`.

## Class Bitmap

Client-scoped CPU RGBA bitmaps; paths feed Layers and share its surface limits. Transient pixels are not runtime snapshots.

Script global: `bitmap`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `beginFixedBlend(slot: number, source: number, options: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Prepare immutable source/destination snapshots with explicit RGBA fixed factors. options:{source:[sx,sy,w,h],destination?:[x,y],clip?:[x,y,w,h],state?:RgbaBlendState}. State fields match the typed Core descriptor: arithmetic:{kind:'float_nearest'} or {kind:'byte255',source:'floor'\|'nearest'\|'ceil',destination:...}; color/alpha:{source:factor,destination:factor,equation:'add'\|'subtract'\|'reverse_subtract'\|'min'\|'max'}, constant,write_mask,source_scale,source_bias,source_alpha_range,source_color_key,source_alpha_key. Factor names are snake_case. Uses revision/scope/epoch-checked effectStatus/cancelEffect, not an owner-thread pixel loop. |
| `beginRowCopy(slot: number, source: number, options: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Prepare a SineRowCopy from a shared bitmap snapshot. Full-image clip; uncovered destination pixels are preserved. Uses effectStatus/cancelEffect. |
| `beginAlphaClip(slot: number, source: number, options: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Prepare clipped stored-coverage multiplication using AlphaClipRect. RGB is retained unless multiply_rgb is explicit; self_source reads the current destination in forward order and requires identical slots. Uses client/epoch/revision-checked effectStatus/cancelEffect. |
| `beginMaskedPair(slot: number, first: number, second: number, options: Record<string, any>)` | `number` | Prepare MaskedPairBlend from three immutable client-owned bitmap snapshots. Independent masks use exact14bit products with separate truncation, retaining destination alpha. Target epoch/revision checks and effectStatus/cancelEffect are shared with other image jobs. |
| `beginTransition(slot: number, other: number, options: Record<string, any>, mask: number \| null)` | `number` | Prepare a snapshot crossfade/rule-mask/blur transition into slot at explicit ImageTransition progress. Inputs must be client-owned equal-size bitmaps. Uses effectStatus/cancelEffect and rejects a stale target revision. |
| `beginEffect(slot: number, effects: Record<string, any>[])` | `number` | Prepare an ImageEffect chain on shared workers. Captures immutable pixels and the target revision; effectStatus publishes only if the client/epoch/revision still match. Max 4M pixels, 16 effects. |
| `effectStatus(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Poll a bitmap effect without waiting. Ready includes result.surface; stale or failed work is visible and does not overwrite newer pixels. |
| `cancelEffect(ticket: number)` | `void` | Release a bitmap effect ticket and cancel unfinished work. Completed published pixels remain engine-owned. |
| `create(slot: number, width: number, height: number, rgba: number[] \| null)` | `string` | Create/replace a slot with uniform RGBA (default transparent). Returns __surface/<slot>. |
| `load(slot: number, source: string)` | `string` | Decode a client asset or copy an existing client surface into a mutable slot. |
| `fill(slot: number, rect: Record<string, any>, rgba: number[])` | `string` | Replace pixels inside clipped {x,y,width,height}; signed positions are allowed. |
| `blit(slot: number, source: string, options: Record<string, any>)` | `string` | Copy/blend source_rect into destination:[x,y]. Explicit mode and opacity; self-copy reads the original pixels. |
| `stretch(slot: number, source: string, options: Record<string, any>)` | `string` | Nearest-neighbor source_rect to destination rectangle with original mapping preserved after clipping. Explicit pixel math. |
| `composite(slot: number, source: string, options: Record<string, any>, coverage: string \| null)` | `string` | Composite associated RGB with copy/over/under, explicit 0..256 weight and preserve/source coverage_write. Optional coverage asset supplies alpha independently of source RGB. Stored channels remain associated; self-copies use snapshots. |
| `filterRgb(slot: number, rect: Record<string, any>, filter: Record<string, any>)` | `string` | Filter RGB bytes, retaining alpha: {kind:'fade',rgb:[r,g,b],weight:0..256} or {kind:'multiply',factors:[0..256,0..256,0..256]}. Fade floors signed deltas. |
| `info(slot: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Return client-local width, height, revision, bytes and surface path. |
| `remove(slot: number)` | `boolean` | Release this client's surface slot; return whether it existed. |


## Class Canvases

Client-scoped retained drawing canvases backed by inspectable engine Layer nodes.

Script global: `canvases`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `getLimits(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Return shared retained-canvas capacity: surfacesPerClient. Pixel-byte, dimension and node limits are admitted separately. |
| `apply(commands: Record<string, any>[])` | `void` | Atomically apply typed canvas commands: create, destroy, clear, draw, set, copy, present, present_isolated, present_target and hide. present_isolated isolates composition with paged output for large surfaces; present_target uses one whole target up to8192 per axis so masks/distortion sample globally across storage pages. Both refresh after source edits. Parent opacity/transform applies after composition; renderer memory/device budgets still apply. Nested snapshot/resource limits fail atomically. Destroy releases an existing unpresented surface; hide its presentations first. Frozen copies survive source destruction. Draws contain ordinary Layer specs, including positioned glyph runs. |
| `applyBatch(batch: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Atomically submit a typed ServiceBatch: prepare_layers before canvases, then world, ordinary layers and UI; input routes are staged in the same transaction. New Canvas parents and real motion producers may be created in prepare_layers without intermediate publication. Existing apply remains canvas-only. At most4096 combined commands and4MiB serialized data; host resource/font preparation applies. |
| `get(id: number)` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | Inspect this client's canvas dimensions and logical draw nodes, or null when absent. No flattened native frame is returned. |
| `readPixel(id: number, x: number, y: number)` | `number[]` | Read exact RGBA bytes from supported retained solid canvas nodes. Missing/outside coordinates and unsupported image/text/group/filter/transform/blend profiles fail; no guessed matte or GPU readback. |

Commands issued: `apply` → `canvas.create`, `apply` → `canvas.clear`, `apply` → `canvas.draw`, `apply` → `canvas.set`, `apply` → `canvas.copy`, `apply` → `canvas.resize`, `apply` → `canvas.fill`, `apply` → `canvas.transform_copy`, `apply` → `canvas.copy_subtree`, `apply` → `canvas.draw_subtree`, `apply` → `canvas.fade`, `apply` → `canvas.filter`, `apply` → `canvas.restore`, `apply` → `canvas.present`, `apply` → `canvas.present_isolated`, `apply` → `canvas.present_target`, `apply` → `canvas.hide`, `apply` → `canvas.destroy`, `apply` → `canvas.retire`.

| `particles` | `any` | read | Particle emitter spec or null. |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `destroy(—)` | `void` | Despawn this entity and its descendants. |
| `setParent(parent: Entity \| null)` | `void` | Re-parent; cycles are rejected. |
| `children(—)` | `Entity[]` | Direct children. |

| `stopAnimation(—)` | `void` | Clear animation (rest pose). |

| `setCollider(collider: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Collider {shape:{kind:'box'\|'sphere'\|'capsule'\|'mesh'\|'convex_hull',...}, body?:'static'\|'dynamic'\|'kinematic'\|'kinematic_position'\|'character',mass?,density?,friction?,restitution?,ccd?,sensor?,groups?,gravity_scale?,linear_damping?,angular_damping?,locked_translation?,locked_rotation?,offset?} or null. |
| `applyImpulse(impulse: Vec3, point: Vec3 \| null)` | `void` | Apply a world-space impulse (N·s), optionally at a world-space point; saves the resulting velocity immediately. |
| `applyTorqueImpulse(impulse: Vec3)` | `void` | Apply a world-space angular impulse to a dynamic body. |
| `addForce(force: Vec3)` | `void` | Accumulate a persistent world-space force (N); saved until clearForces(). |
| `addTorque(torque: Vec3)` | `void` | Accumulate persistent world-space torque (N·m). |
| `clearForces(—)` | `void` | Clear persistent force and torque. |
| `wake(—)` | `void` | Wake a physics body. |
| `sleep(—)` | `void` | Sleep a physics body when can_sleep is enabled. |
| `setKinematicTarget(position: Vec3, rotation: Vec3 \| null)` | `void` | World-space target for a kinematic_position body at the next fixed step; rotation is XYZ degrees. |
| `setVehicle(spec: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Make this character-collider entity an arcade vehicle (ADR 0043): {wheelbase, track, ride_height, suspension, max_speed, acceleration, braking, drag, steer_degrees, steer_falloff, grip, handbrake_grip, gravity, step, max_slope} (all optional); null removes it. Vehicle state is not saved yet. |
| `drive(input: Record<string, any>, dt: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Advance the vehicle by dt seconds with {throttle -1..1, steer -1..1 (positive toward +X of the heading), brake 0..1, handbrake}; moves and orients the entity. Returns {speed, lateral, grounded, wheels, blocked, yaw}. |
| `moveCharacter(desired: Vec3, dt: number, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Move a character capsule with sliding, autostep and slope limits; returns {translation, grounded}. options {step?: 0.3, maxSlope?: 45}. |

| `setReflectionProbe(probe: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Box reflection capture {extent:[hx,hy,hz], intensity?, blend_distance?, revision?} at this entity, or null. Bump revision to recapture. |

| `setParticles(emitter: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `void` | Particle emitter {rate, burst, lifetime, speed, direction, spread_degrees, gravity, drag, size, color_start, color_end, max, additive, enabled, seed} or null. |

| `drainAnimEvents(—)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Take notifies/state changes {kind, name}. |

| `attribute(name: string)` | `number \| null` | Current value after active effects, or null. |
| `setAttribute(name: string, base: number)` | `void` | Set an attribute's base value. |
| `applyEffect(effect: string, source: Entity \| null)` | `boolean` | Apply a gameplay effect; false if blocked by tags. |

## Class Input

Session-scoped keyboard/mouse/gamepad actions with runtime rebinding and semantic prompt tokens.

Script global: `input`.

| Property | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|

| `pointerDelta` | `number[]` | read | Pointer delta this frame. |
| `keys` | `string[]` | read | Supported physical key names. |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `pointerActivity(—)` | `string \| null` | Read the live backend pointer-motion token as an exact decimal string; null when unavailable. Actual movement/entry changes it even when rounded canvas coordinates stay the same. This is independent of input-frame revisions and snapshot state. |
| `observation(—)` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | Last owner-admitted input sample with exact revision/time/button strings and optional pointer/inside/focus metadata. Null before admission or after restore. Querying does not consume events or infer a default pointer. |
| `keyboardLocks(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | This client's logical Caps/Num/Scroll lock state and revision. Physical state is null unless imported; logical control never toggles the OS keyboard. Session state resets only on successful Runtime restore. |
| `setKeyboardLocks(state: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Patch this client's logical caps_lock/num_lock/scroll_lock. mode must be logical; physical requests fail explicitly. Returns owner-committed state/revision, not device success. |
| `enableEvents(capacity: number)` | `void` | Enable/replace this client's opt-in logical input journal (1..4096 samples). Accepted App frames feed it once. Disabled by default; action queries remain independent. Overflow is visible, with no silent edge drop. |
| `disableEvents(—)` | `void` | Release this client's journal. Old receipts cannot affect a newly enabled journal. |
| `events(maximum: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Publish an ordered prefix {samples:[InputSample],receipt:InputReceipt\|null}. Reads are idempotent until acknowledgement; leased samples cannot be rewritten by pointer-motion coalescing. Journal JSON u64 values are exact decimal strings (including masks, sequences and timestamps); echo receipts directly. Records model framed digital buttons/pointer, not raw OS/text/gamepad-axis events. |
| `ackEvents(receipt: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Acknowledge only a published prefix for this client and epoch. Stale/foreign receipts fail without consuming input. |
| `eventStats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | enabled,client,epoch,pending,capacity. Does not publish or consume samples. Queues are scoped independently of action bindings. |
| `captureEvents(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Capture portable InputBufferSnapshot logical intents. Contains no device handles. Existing Runtime restore disables public journals; restoreEvents explicitly restores captured data. |
| `restoreEvents(snapshot: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Validate and atomically replace a logical journal under a fresh epoch. Snapshot observation time must not exceed the current owner clock. Never restores hardware handles or action-map device state. |
| `bind(action: string, keys: string[])` | `void` | Replace keyboard bindings. |
| `rebind(action: string, spec: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Replace {bindings:[{kind:'key'\|'button'\|'axis',...}],threshold?:0.5}. Validated atomically. |
| `bindings(action: string)` | `Record<string, any>` | Read action bindings. |
| `isDown(action: string)` | `boolean` | Action magnitude exceeds threshold. |
| `pressed(action: string)` | `boolean` | Action crossed threshold or bound button pressed this frame. |
| `released(action: string)` | `boolean` | Action released this frame. |
| `value(action: string)` | `number` | Combined analog/digital signed value in -1..1. |
| `axis(negative: string, positive: string)` | `number` | Positive action magnitude minus negative action magnitude. |
| `prompt(action: string)` | `Record<string, any>` | Preferred binding {device,family,control,label,icon}; icon is a semantic asset token. |
| `setPromptFamily(family: string \| null)` | `void` | Override generic/xbox/playstation/nintendo labels; null restores detection. |
| `exportBindings(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Return schema-1 profile for fs.writeSave. |
| `importBindings(profile: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Validate and replace complete logical profile; raw hardware state is not restored. |
| `startRebind(action: string)` | `void` | Capture next pressed key/button or large axis motion. |
| `cancelRebind(—)` | `void` | Cancel pending capture. |
| `takeRebind(—)` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | Drain the completed capture result. |


## Class InputRoutes

Client-scoped device-event receivers with stable priority, explicit delivery receipts, capture and cancellation. Interactive Widget mixing and simultaneous active receiver clients are explicitly unsupported in the current routing profile.

Script global: `inputRoutes`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `put(receiver: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Register/update a bounded receiver with signed priority, source mask, optional half-open pointer rect/coverage and enabled/hover flags. |
| `remove(id: number)` | `void` | Remove an owned receiver; stale capture/delivery cannot activate a different receiver. |
| `clear(—)` | `void` | Clear this client's receivers and pending input state. |
| `setEnabled(id: number, enabled: boolean)` | `void` | Enable or disable a registered receiver. |
| `setPriority(id: number, priority: number)` | `void` | Set signed priority, high first, preserving equal-priority stable history. |
| `delivery(—)` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | Lease the next routed event. Repeated polls retain the same receipt until acknowledgement; u64 receipt fields are exact decimal strings. |
| `acknowledge(receipt: Record<string, any>, handled: boolean)` | `void` | Acknowledge exactly the current scoped receipt. Unhandled events continue to the next eligible receiver; stale or foreign receipts fail. |
| `cancel(—)` | `void` | Cancel transient delivery/capture state without synthesizing input. |
| `receiver(id: number)` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | Inspect one owned receiver, or null when absent. |
| `stats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Inspect bounded receiver/journal/delivery state; this does not inject a device event. |

Commands issued: `put` → `input_route.put`, `remove` → `input_route.remove`, `clear` → `input_route.clear`, `setEnabled` → `input_route.set_enabled`, `setPriority` → `input_route.set_priority`, `acknowledge` → `input_route.acknowledge`, `cancel` → `input_route.cancel`.

Equal depths preserve the last committed frame order; ordinary layers draw before depth scopes. Null restores ordinary order. This does not change geometric position. |

Engine duration uses milliseconds; external duration uses caller units. |

## Class Media

Shared asynchronous media resources; decoding, clocks and errors belong to the engine.

Script global: `media`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `beginProbe(asset: string)` | `number` | Begin scoped video decoder/header preparation without playback, pictures or PCM. probeStatus retains Pending/Ready/Failed; audio facts remain unknown when not probed. |
| `probeStatus(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Poll header preparation without joining; Ready exposes size/container/video decoder, optional audio facts, frame_ms and exact duration_ms as a decimal string or null. |
| `releaseProbe(ticket: number)` | `void` | Release this client's header probe; unfinished work is cancelled. Tickets become obsolete after restore. |
| `play(id: number, asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `string` | Start a scoped media resource; options {loop?:false,audio?:true,gain?:1}. Returns its logical image resource path for Layer/Canvas/Material APIs; inspect status for loading, playback and errors. |
| `stop(id: number)` | `void` | Stop only this client's media resource. |
| `setGain(id: number, gain: number)` | `void` | Set finite 0..4 media audio gain without restarting decoding, changing the presentation clock or affecting another client. Loading/paused resources retain the value for their next audio start. |
| `gain(id: number)` | `number \| null` | Read this client's retained media gain; null when the resource is absent. |
| `remove(id: number)` | `void` | Release this client's media resource and decoded surface after detaching its image references. |
| `pause(id: number)` | `void` | Freeze the media clock; audio stops and the current picture stays. |
| `resume(id: number)` | `void` | Continue a paused media clock; audio restarts at the matching offset. |
| `setClock(id: number, nowMs: any)` | `void` | Select a monotonic external video clock before first playback, then supply clock samples. Exact nonnegative integers or decimal strings are accepted. The engine owns pause/seek/loop offsets; decoded audio tracks require audio-master mapping and currently fail explicitly. |
| `seek(id: number, position_ms: number)` | `void` | Restart decoding and present the picture due at position_ms (stream time); earlier pictures are decoded but not published. A paused resource stays paused there. |
| `status(id: number)` | `Record<string, any> \| null` | Media state, position_ms, frame_pts_ms, published/decoded frames, audio_started, loops_completed, paused, validated size, declared duration_ms and error, or null when absent. Size/duration remain null while pending or unknown. |

Commands issued: `play` → `media.play`, `stop` → `media.stop`, `status` → `service.media_status`.

## Class Physics

Persistent client-isolated rigid bodies, CCD, collision queries and joints. Simulation runs in every Runtime 16 ms world step, including pure data projects. Snapshots rebuild from saved pose, velocity, forces and joint declarations; solver warm starts are not serialized.

| Property | Type | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gravity` | `Vec3` | read/write | Client gravity in world units/s². |
| `stats` | `Record<string, any>` | read | Bodies/colliders/joints, sleeping counts, stable-handle updates, shape-cache and fixed-step counters for this client. |

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `raycast(origin: Vec3, direction: Vec3, maxDistance: number, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `any` | Closest hit {entity,point,normal,distance} or null. Options {ignore?:Entity,groups?:{memberships,filter},sensors?:false,staticOnly?:false}; never queries another client. |
| `sphereCast(origin: Vec3, direction: Vec3, radius: number, maxDistance: number, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `any` | Sweep a sphere. Returns its center at impact as point, surface normal, travel distance and a scoped entity or null. |
| `castShape(shape: Record<string, any>, pose: Record<string, any>, direction: Vec3, maxDistance: number, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `any` | Sweep box/sphere/capsule/convex_hull. Pose {translation?:Vec3,rotation_degrees?:Vec3}; dimensions are world units. Hit point is the moving shape origin at impact. |
| `overlapShape(shape: Record<string, any>, pose: Record<string, any>, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Entity[]` | All scoped bodies intersecting the supplied world-space shape; sensors are opt-in. |
| `createJoint(a: Entity, b: Entity, spec: Record<string, any>)` | `PhysicsJoint` | Create fixed/spherical/revolute/prismatic joint. Local anchors/frames, axes, optional limits and motor; revolute motor/limits use radians, prismatic meters. Saved with generational body identities. |
| `events(—)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Drain this client's contact/sensor/force/sleep events {kind,entity,other,force,forceMagnitude}. Bounded queue; counters report dropped events. |

Commands issued: `gravity` → `world.set_physics`.

| `detectFile(asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Offline probe of native file/audio decoders with per-plugin read budgets. Options {profile?}; live hosts use beginDecode with automatic detection, and ambiguous formats require an explicit decoder. |
| `readDecoded(asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Decode a file/audio resource and return metadata plus a bounded byte page. Options {format?,profile?,offset?,limit?}, default 4096 and maximum 65536 bytes. Decoding is CPU work; live callers should schedule it as an asset task. |
| `mountDecoded(asset: string, target: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Decode once and publish a client-scoped VFS resource at target. Normal Bitmap/Assets/Audio calls can consume it. Options {format?,profile?}; retained output shares the client's decode budget and no extracted file is written. |
| `beginProbe(asset: string, kind: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `number` | Probe archive/file/image formats on bounded workers. Poll decodeStatus and readDecode; no source opening or decoder runs on the owner. |
| `beginImage(asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `number` | Decode a native image and its scoped companions on workers. Options {format?,profile?}. publishImage commits ready immutable pixels without a main-thread copy. Retained results charge the client profile and a host-wide 256 MiB staging budget; cancelDecode releases the ticket. |
| `publishImage(ticket: number, slot: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Publish a completed image into an engine surface slot. No decoding or pixel copy occurs during this owner commit. |
| `beginDecode(asset: string, kind: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `number` | Schedule file/audio conversion (kind=file) or archive indexing (kind=archive) on the bounded CPU pool. Options {format?,profile?}. Returns a scoped ticket; owner calls never join. At most 64 retained tickets per client and 256 per host. |
| `decodeStatus(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Poll pending/ready/failed resource work without blocking. A completed decoder failure remains visible until cancelled. |
| `readDecode(ticket: number, offset: number \| null, limit: number \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Read a ready file's bounded byte page (maximum 65536) or archive metadata page (maximum 1024 entries). Pending work fails visibly rather than waiting or returning fabricated data. |
| `mountDecode(ticket: number, target: string, fallback: boolean \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Publish a completed worker result into this client's VFS. For files target is a full logical filename; for archives it is a mount directory. Optional fallback=true puts existing overlays and real loose files ahead of this provider; default false preserves ordinary overlay priority. No CPU decoder runs during publication. |
| `cancelDecode(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel pending work or release a retained result. Late worker output is discarded. Already mounted readers retain their own decoded-resource reservation. |
| `transforms(—)` | `string[]` | List installed byte transform IDs; profiles refer to keys supplied by the Rust host. |
| `imageFormats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | List installed native image format IDs and standard image extensions; the runtime, Bitmap, text icons and renderer use this same registry. |
| `probeImage(asset: string)` | `string[]` | Return recognized native image IDs from bounded client asset bytes. Specific wrappers outrank their generic embedded codec during automatic decode. |
| `decodeImage(slot: number, asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `string` | Decode a client image into __surface/<slot> for Bitmap/Layer/UI/3D use. Options {format?,profile?}; external bases/masks use the same scoped VFS and keys remain in the host provider. |
| `defineProfile(name: string, profile: Record<string, any>)` | `void` | Define an immutable client profile {limits?,parameters?:{format:options},rules:[{format,path?,transforms:[{algorithm,key_id?,parameters?,expected_size?}]}]}. Native options name client key aliases/companions; secret bytes remain in the host KeyProvider. Up to 32 profiles; default is created lazily. |
| `probe(asset: string)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Probe an asset using installed formats with bounded reads. Ambiguous signatures require an explicit format when opening. |
| `list(asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Inspect archive metadata. Options {format?,profile?,offset?,limit?}; default 128 and at most 1024 entries per page. |
| `mount(asset: string, mountPoint: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Record<string, any>` | Mount archive entries in this client's asset VFS, then use normal bitmap, audio and model APIs. Options {format?,profile?}. Native paths are validated; keys and decoded bytes are not saved. |


## Class Save

Client-capability snapshot operations. Captures preserve ordered VM safepoints; worker jobs perform encoding, disk I/O and validation, and prepared loads commit atomically.

Script global: `save`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `save(path: string)` | `number` | Offline snapshot/write; realtime hosts use beginSave. Returns encoded byte size. |
| `load(path: string)` | `void` | Offline read/restore; realtime hosts use beginLoad then commitLoad. A failed restore leaves the runtime unchanged. |
| `exists(path: string)` | `boolean` | Offline existence query; realtime hosts use beginExists. Permission/read errors remain errors. |
| `beginSave(path: string)` | `number` | Capture logical state and native VM checkpoints at the current owner safepoint, then serialize and write on bounded CPU/I/O workers. Returns a client ticket. Native checkpoint capture itself remains ordered. |
| `beginLoad(path: string)` | `number` | Read, decode and validate a snapshot on workers. A ready result is prepared, not applied; commitLoad publishes it at an owner safepoint. |
| `beginExists(path: string)` | `number` | Query the save capability on the bounded I/O executor. Only NotFound becomes false. |
| `status(ticket: number)` | `Record<string, any>` | Poll pending/ready/failed without joining workers. Ready save returns bytes; exists returns exists; load returns prepared=true. All tickets are client/generation checked. |
| `commitLoad(ticket: number)` | `void` | Atomically apply a prepared load, preserving native restore semantics. Reject pending, wrong-kind and obsolete results. Successful restore invalidates earlier-generation jobs. |
| `cancel(ticket: number)` | `void` | Cancel/release retained work. Running atomic writes may already commit; cancellation cannot undo an existing disk write. |

Commands issued: `save` → `runtime.snapshot`, `load` → `runtime.restore`.

| `remove(name: string)` | `void` | Remove block and release its dynamic surface. |

## Class Vfx

Engine-owned modular visual effects. Systems are data, particles execute on bounded CPU workers or native GPU compute; JS/TS controls instances and parameters.

Script global: `vfx`.

| Method | Returns | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `compile(system: Record<string, any>)` | `Record<string, any>` | Validate a modular system and typed parameter bindings without opening a device. Returns its emitter/module/target summary; unsupported modules fail. |
| `play(system: Record<string, any>, options: Record<string, any> \| null)` | `Entity` | Spawn an entity with this VFX system. Options are ordinary World.spawn fields such as name, position, rotation, scale and parent. Simulation is published asynchronously. |
| `setParameter(entity: Entity, name: string, value: any)` | `void` | Change an existing typed parameter on this client's VFX entity without restarting its particles. |
| `pause(entity: Entity, paused: boolean)` | `void` | Freeze/resume the effect's simulation clock. |
| `stop(entity: Entity)` | `void` | Stop emission while existing particles finish. |
| `restart(entity: Entity)` | `void` | Restart an effect from its seed using a new logical revision. |
| `stats(—)` | `Record<string, any>` | Read this client's published CPU counts, GPU timeline pressure and pending worker status. GPU capacity is not reported as a measured live count. |
| `sequenceStatus(entity: Entity, revision: any, completedTick: any, exchangeEpoch: any)` | `Record<string, any>` | Query a completed worker RNG receipt for a live owned entity/revision. Counters accept exact nonnegative integers or decimal strings; large returned counters use decimal strings. Pending work never exposes the declared seed as completed state. |
| `drainEvents(—)` | `Record<string, any>[]` | Drain this client's bounded CPU birth, death and collision event queue. GPU event records remain on device; they are not fabricated as CPU callbacks. |

## Data

Field defaults are the serde defaults (`—`: required, or absent when unset).

### ImageCompositeMath

Used by: Rust typed immutable-image composite arithmetic; resource graph operation, not a JSON command or reflected class.

Explicit byte arithmetic for immutable bitmap composition. These profiles operate on stored RGBA, independently of the eventual display alpha policy.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `IntegerStored` | `destination_format: u8, source_format: u8, mode: i32, parameter: i32` | Explicit stored-byte bitmap arithmetic. Extra layer opacity is forbidden; the native integer parameter selects its own 0..256 coverage semantics. |
| `Normalized` | `crate::image_blend::RgbaBlendState` | Explicit normalized fragment/factor state; layer opacity must be255. |
| `Copy` | — | — |
| `CopyRgb` | — | Copy the colour channels, keep the destination alpha. |
| `CopyAlpha` | — | Copy/opacity-lerp the stored alpha byte, retaining destination RGB. Opacity uses the same rounded /255 interpolation as Copy/CopyRgb. |
| `OpaqueScalar256` | — | Encoded RGB d + floor((s-d)*opacity/256), destination alpha zero. Full opacity copies all four channels exactly. |
| `MaskScalar256` | — | Encoded RGB interpolation with source alpha (times opacity/256 when opacity < 255). Writes alpha zero, including transparent source pixels. |
| `MaskHoldAlphaScalar256` | — | MaskScalar256's RGB interpolation, keeping the destination alpha (krkr `_HDA` hold-destination-alpha blend). |
| `MaskPiecewise256` | `weight: u16` | mask0 skips; mask255 uses weight/(256-weight), partial mask uses a=mask*weight>>8 and255-a; sum then/256, keeping destination alpha. Composite-layer opacity must be255; weight is0..=256. |
| `MaskSeparate256` | — | Mask0 skips, mask255 copies RGB; partial RGB is floor(s*a/256) + floor(d*(256-a)/256). Retains destination alpha; opacity must be255. |
| `MaskIncrement256` | — | Mask0 skips, mask255 copies RGB; partial mask uses source weight a+1 and destination weight255-a, then a single /256 truncation. Destination alpha is retained, and composite-layer opacity must be255. |
| `OpaqueOnAlphaScalar256` | — | Opaque input over a straight-alpha destination with scalar /256 tables. |
| `AlphaOnAlphaScalar256` | — | Straight-alpha input over straight-alpha destination, scalar /256 tables. |
| `Ps` | `blend: PsBlend, hold_alpha: bool` | Photoshop-like colour blend (krkr `tvpps.c` tables); `hold_alpha` keeps the destination alpha, otherwise alpha is written as zero. |

### RgbaBlendArithmetic

Used by: Rust floating nearest or independently rounded /255 integer products.

Explicit arithmetic profiles. Byte255 is integer table arithmetic, including transform quantization before either product. Constants/scales/biases become nearest signed byte-unit coefficients; transform is floor(s*scale255/255)+ bias255, clamped0..255. Product rounding is independent for the two terms; equation results clamp0..255. Min/Max ignore product factors/rounding.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `FloatNearest` | — | — |
| `Byte255` | `source: RgbaByteRounding, destination: RgbaByteRounding` | — |
| `Byte255Sum` | `rounding: RgbaByteRounding` | Byte255 transforms and factors, but the signed sum of both unscaled products is divided by255 once: `round((s*fs +/- d*fd)/255)`. Native integer alpha blitters (e.g. Circus DC2 40B5F0) divide the whole sum. |
| `ByteShiftSum` | `shift: u8` | Integer power-of-two weights: `(s*fs +/- d*fd) >> shift`, where only One/Zero/Constant*/OneMinusConstant* factors are admitted and constants are rounded to multiples of `1/(1<<shift)` (e.g. 16-level native blits). |

### RgbaBlendState

Used by: Rust checked fragment transform, gates, colour/alpha equations and channel write mask; Bitmap.beginFixedBlend options map.

CPU encoded-UNORM8 profile. Raw source keys and inclusive alpha range discard a whole fragment before the source transform. The fragment is then clamp(source/255*scale+bias,0,1), without intermediate byte quantization. Factors read that fragment and the original destination/255. Color and alpha have independent equations; final channels clamp0..1 and round to UNORM8. The default arithmetic is binary32. Byte255 is selected explicitly. There is no sRGB conversion, alpha unpremultiply, /256 approximation, or claim of bit-identical rounding on every GPU driver.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `arithmetic` | `RgbaBlendArithmetic` | — | — |
| `color` | `RgbaBlendComponent` | — | — |
| `alpha` | `RgbaBlendComponent` | — | — |
| `constant` | `[f32; 4]` | — | — |
| `write_mask` | `[bool; 4]` | — | — |
| `source_scale` | `[f32; 4]` | — | Each scale and bias is finite within -64..64. |
| `source_bias` | `[f32; 4]` | — | — |
| `source_alpha_range` | `[f32; 2]` | — | Inclusive raw source alpha range in0..1; default[0,1] discards nothing. |
| `source_color_key` | `Option<[u8; 3]>` | — | Exact original encoded RGB/alpha keys, before source transformation. |
| `source_alpha_key` | `Option<u8>` | — | — |
| `source_color_key_invert` | `bool` | — | Invert `source_color_key`: only fragments equal to the key are kept (native "copy key colour only" hole punches). |

### ScanlineMath

Used by: Explicit stored-byte scanline RGB arithmetic including raw mask complements without endpoint shortcuts.

Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `stored` | `math: ByteRasterMath` | — |
| `coverage_separate` | `weight: u32, opaque_copy: bool` | Multiply stored source coverage by a32-bit wrapping weight, then take bits8..23. Source/destination products wrap to16bits and floor separately; the destination weight XORs the source weight's low byte with255. |
| `constant_separate` | `weights: [u16; 2]` | Independent packed-word RGB weights; products floor separately and their sum saturates to255. Coverage is ignored, destination alpha is retained. |
| `constant_summed` | `weights: [u16; 2]` | Multiply stored RGB by independent low-word weights, add with16-bit wrapping, then shift once by8. Coverage is ignored; alpha is retained. |
| `coverage_summed` | `weight: u32` | Skip zero coverage; otherwise multiply it by a wrapping32-bit weight, take bits8..15, and copy at255. Partial RGB uses that byte and its255 complement, with one final shift after the16-bit wrapping sum. |
| `coverage_raw_summed` | `weight: u16, complement: u16` | Scale coverage with a low-word product /256, use its wrapping complement, sum low-word RGB products before one /256 truncation. Every coverage value participates, including0 and255; alpha is retained. |
| `coverage_word_separate` | `weight: u16, complement: u16, opaque_copy: bool` | Low-word scaled coverage and explicit complement with separate product floors. |
| `coverage_byte_separate` | `weight: u32` | Skip original coverage0. Scale coverage by a wrapping32-bit weight and shift by8; the complete result255 copies RGB. Otherwise use the low bytes of that result and256-result as weights, floor each product by256 independently and saturate their sum. A scaled result0 paints black. |

### RectMapSample

Used by: Exact rational or independently quantized nearest-neighbour rectangle sampling.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `floor` | — | — |
| `floor_quantized` | `fractional_bits: [Option<u8>;2]` | Nearest sampling with independently quantized source increments. None uses the exact rational phase; Some(n) floors the increment to n fractional bits before multiplying by the destination coordinate. |
| `nearest_round` | — | round(i*source_extent/destination_extent), clamped inside the rectangle. The clamp repairs the otherwise out-of-rectangle final upscale sample. |
| `nearest_round_linear` | — | Round the rational table without clipping to the source subrectangle. Coordinates address the complete immutable image in linear row order; a sample at X==image.width carries into the following row. Only an address outside the complete allocation clamps to its nearest endpoint. This bounded profile preserves initialized border samples of native table kernels without reproducing reads of uninitialized memory. |

### BoxArithmetic

Used by: Full mean, packed high product/half-and-double, or explicitly weighted quad arithmetic.

Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `half_word_high_double` | `multiplier: u16` | Wrap to16 bits, logically halve, signed high multiply, double the word, then signed-saturate to a byte. Describes native packed blur arithmetic. |
| `mean` | — | Unsigned full-precision sum divided by the complete window area. |
| `weighted_quad` | `weights: [u16; 4], divisor: u16` | Explicit row-major weights for a2x2 window. The unsigned sum is divided once and saturated to a byte; this also describes asymmetric filters. |
| `signed_word_high` | `multiplier: u16` | Wrap each channel sum to16 bits, interpret sum and multiplier as signed words, take the signed product's high word, then saturate to a byte. This is an explicit packed-integer contract, not a float approximation. |

### BoxAnchors

Used by: Grid, valid-window origins, proportional or rational-area reduction windows.

Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `window_origins` | — | Window origins span every valid source start: floor((extent-window+1) * index/output). Uses bounded column sums instead of repeated taps. |
| `grid` | `stride: [u32; 2]` | The first window starts at the crop origin. Subsequent windows advance by an independent integer stride on each axis. |
| `proportional` | — | Window starts are floor(crop_extent * output_index / output_extent). |
| `area` | — | Exact area overlaps between rational source/output pixel boxes. The window is ignored; only Mean arithmetic is meaningful for this profile. |

### ByteRasterMath

Used by: ByteRaster explicit stored-byte copy or alpha composition policy.

Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `signed_scaled_masked_rgb256` | `scale: i16, subtract: bool` | Signed packed-word RGB scaling, saturated add/subtract, then separate mask products /256, including full255 coverage without a shortcut. |
| `alpha_percent_rgb256` | `percent: u8` | Scale stored coverage by an integer percent /100, then sum RGB products before /256. Coverage0 skips; scaled255 copies RGB. |
| `saturated_rgb` | `subtract: bool` | Independent saturated stored-RGB addition or subtraction; no coverage modulation and no alpha writes. |
| `alpha_weighted_rgb256` | `weight: u16` | Scale stored coverage by weight/256. Zero coverage skips, 255 copies RGB; partial contributions are summed before one /256 truncation. Destination alpha is retained independently of the coverage source. |
| `alpha_weighted_separate_rgb256` | `weight: u16` | Scale source coverage by weight/256, then floor the two RGB products separately. Only source alpha255 plus weight256 copies RGB directly. Destination alpha is retained; weight is0..=256. |
| `mask_piecewise_wrapping256` | `weight: u16` | Piecewise stored-mask blend with explicit low-word arithmetic. Mask0 skips; mask255 uses(weight,256-weight). Partial masks use the high byte of the wrapping mask*weight product and its255 complement. All RGB products/sums wrap to16bits before /256; destination alpha is retained. |
| `copy_rgb` | — | — |
| `alpha_threshold_rgb` | `threshold: u8` | Copy RGB when the stored source coverage reaches the inclusive threshold. |
| `copy_alpha` | — | — |
| `copy_rgba` | — | — |
| `constant_rgb255` | `opacity: u8` | Two separate floor products /255; source coverage is ignored. |
| `alpha_rgb255` | — | Two separate floor products /255, using stored source coverage. |

### Mt19937Split

### AudioPlaybackInfo

Used by: Audio.playbackInfo / nativeChannelInfo / HostServices.audio_info.

Shared source transport inspection. Processing tails do not prolong source completion. Frame positions are decoded-source units; fade/delay counts use output_rate. No device or executable pointers cross this boundary.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source_peak` | `f32` | — | Peak absolute source PCM in the last completed mixer block, before gain, bus, pan and spatial processing. Paused/inactive sources report 0. |
| `source_taps` | `[f32; 4]` | — | Signed source samples at interleaved block indices 0, N/4, 3N/4 and N-2, before gain, panning, channel exchange and per-voice effects. They support inexpensive presentation/lip-sync meters without exposing a decoder buffer or its lifetime. Inactive sources return zeroes. |
| `balance` | `AudioBalanceInfo` | — | Mixer-owner observation of the independent external dB balance track. |
| `source_playing` | `bool` | — | Source has remaining input, even when paused; excludes processing tails. |
| `first_pass_complete` | `bool` | — | At least one source/loop endpoint has been reached by mixer transport. Latched until this voice is replaced; decoder read-ahead, pause, gain and wall time alone cannot set it. A joined intro belongs to the first pass; later passes begin at the configured loop start. Seek preserves it. |
| `paused` | `bool` | — | Source clock currently frozen by pause or a freezing scheduled resume. |
| `retain_on_finish` | `bool` | — | Canonical source retention/protection policy of this allocated voice. |
| `transport_active` | `bool` | — | Whether input/per-voice DSP may run. Separate from full Pause and from source_playing, which reports remaining input even when inactive. |
| `looping` | `bool` | — | Actual prepared source loop mode. |
| `loop_passes` | `Option<u32>` | — | Remaining range passes including the current pass; None is unbounded when looping, or no counted schedule when looping is disabled. |

### AudioRequest

Used by: Rust client-scoped HostServices audio commands; resource-bearing enum, not a JSON command or reflected class.

Client-scoped channel commands for the shared decoder/mixer. Encoded bytes and decoder resources are not part of logical VM snapshots.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `PlayPlaylist` | `channel: u32, source: AudioPlaylist, parameters: AudioParameters` | Bounded segmented source, decoded on the existing audio worker. Nested repeats do not expand encoded data or decoded PCM in memory. |
| `PlayResident` | `channel: u32, source: EncodedAudio, intro: Option<EncodedAudio>, parameters: AudioParameters` | Decode all bounded input frames before publication. Playback, loops and exact seeks subsequently use resident PCM without a decoder/I/O worker. |
| `Balance` | `channel: u32, command: AudioBalanceCommand` | Control the independent dB balance on this client's channel. Missing sources remain a no-op; newly published voices start centered. |
| `ExchangeChannels` | `left: u32, right: u32` | Atomically exchange two logical channels in this client. The existing voice/source handles, fractional cursor, DSP history and gain/transport ramps remain intact. An empty side moves the other voice. Unpublished preparation intents, pending seeks/retirements or an active render lease reject before mutation. This is unrelated to decoded left/right exchange. |
| `SetMixGroupGain` | `name: String, gain: f32, fade_ms: f32` | Set only a group's gain, creating a root with default settings if absent. Existing parent and mute controls remain host-owned. |
| `SetMixGroup` | `name: String, settings: AudioMixGroupSettings, fade_ms: f32` | Configure an owner-scoped gain group, with atomic parent/cycle/budget validation and an output-clock fade. Does not open an audio source. |
| `PlayResource` | `channel: u32, resource: AudioResourceHandle, parameters: AudioParameters` | Open an independent decoder over an existing immutable encoded resource on workers. Releasing its handle does not invalidate admitted/live work. |
| `PlayPcm` | `channel: u32, source: PcmAudio, parameters: AudioParameters` | Publish a worker-prepared PCM resource without opening a codec. |
| `PlayAsset` | `channel: u32, source: AudioAsset, intro: Option<AudioAsset>, parameters: AudioParameters` | Worker preparation only; synchronous submission must reject this variant. |
| `Play` | `channel: u32, source: EncodedAudio, intro: Option<EncodedAudio>, parameters: AudioParameters` | — |
| `Stop` | `channel: u32, fade_ms: f32` | — |
| `SetTransportActive` | `channel: u32, active: bool` | Park/re-enable input and per-voice DSP without reopening a decoder, resetting gain or cancelling a seek. Independent gain/pan clocks keep running unless fully paused. Ended sources must seek before activation. |
| `Pause` | `channel: u32, paused: bool, fade_ms: f32` | — |
| `Resume` | `channel: u32, delay_ms: f32, fade_ms: f32` | Freeze the source now, then resume after an output-clock delay with a fresh fade-in. A later pause/stop/resume replaces this scheduled action. |
| `ResumeWithOptions` | `channel: u32, delay_ms: f32, fade_ms: f32, settings: AudioResumeSettings` | Resume at an output-clock deadline with explicit pre-deadline transport. Later pause/stop/resume replaces this action; readiness is independent. |
| `SetRate` | `channel: u32, rate: f32` | Change the source playback multiplier without seeking, restarting or resetting resampler/DSP history. Pitch, looping and transport survive. |
| `SetEcho` | `channel: u32, effect: Option<StereoEchoSpec>` | Replace a live voice's bounded stereo delay. None removes the effect. A missing voice is unchanged; no source is opened by this control. |
| `SetStereoEffect` | `channel: u32, effect: Option<StereoEffectSpec>` | Replace a live voice's portable chorus/reverb; None clears it. |
| `SetGain` | `channel: u32, gain: f32, fade_ms: f32` | — |
| `FadeGain` | `channel: u32, gain: f32, fade_ms: f32, stop_after: bool` | Fade the own amplitude to a target, optionally stop when that ramp finishes. Unlike Stop this adds no independent envelope toward zero. |
| `FinishGainFade` | `channel: u32` | Finish the current own-amplitude ramp at its retained target. A pending gain-stop retires the voice; independent transport deadlines stay intact. |
| `SetPan` | `channel: u32, pan: f32, fade_ms: f32` | — |
| `SetStereoGain` | `channel: u32, gains: [f32; 2], fade_ms: f32` | Independent post-processing left/right amplitude controls, each0..4. Unity preserves the current pan/spatial law. This is not equal-power pan. |
| `SetLoopSchedule` | `channel: u32, start: u64, end: Option<u64>, passes: Option<u32>` | Replace the decoded-frame loop range and remaining-pass schedule while retaining the current fractional cursor. None passes repeats unbounded; Some must be positive, including the current pass. None end uses EOF. |
| `SetTrackGains` | `channel: u32, positions: Option<alloc::vec::Vec<u64>>, changes: alloc::vec::Vec<AudioTrackGain>` | Retarget track gains of a multi-track voice from its current source frame, or (with `positions`) at the first listed source frame reached; a new deferred request replaces an unapplied one. |
| `SetChannelSwap` | `channel: u32, swapped: bool` | Exchange decoded left/right channels without restarting transport. |
| `SetLooped` | `channel: u32, looping: bool, loop_start: Option<u64>` | Change loop mode at the current source position; never restart/seek. Enabling restores unbounded repeats, clearing a prior counted schedule. |

### AdaptiveStepClock

Used by: Rust-only bounded adaptive fixed-step debt over caller-owned elapsed time; new selects zero lookahead, with_lookahead is explicit, every state-changing method validates the finite signed32 domain; no VM/device/reflective class.

Serializable adaptive step scheduling state. All methods validate restored state before use; malformed or overflowing updates leave the state unchanged. Configuration follows signed32 finite arithmetic, rejecting its overflow domain rather than relying on a platform's unchecked integer behaviour.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `period_ms` | `i32` | `50` | Positive fixed-step duration in milliseconds. |
| `maximum_steps` | `i32` | `2` | Maximum planned work per owner update. |
| `horizon` | `i32` | `10` | Positive response horizon measured in fixed steps. |
| `lookahead_steps` | `i32` | `0` | Explicit prediction lead; zero reacts to existing debt only. |
| `debt_ms` | `i32` | `0` | Signed unconsumed time; overpayment is bounded below. |
| `planned_steps` | `i32` | `0` | Last adaptive work plan, bounded by maximum_steps. |
| `consumed` | `bool` | `true` | Whether this open update performed even a zero consumption. |
| `open` | `bool` | `false` | Whether begin has opened an update that still requires end. |

### AudioReleaseSpec

Used by: Rust HostServices.begin_audio_release.

Immutable release policy. Volume units are hundredths of one dB (db100). Source/cursor transfer and all interpolation are owned by the audio service.

|---|---|---|---|
| `source_channel` | `u32` | — | Channel vacated by the live decoder without reopening or seeking. |

| `threshold_db100` | `i32` | — | Captured levels at/above this select target_above_db100. |
| `target_above_db100` | `i32` | — | Target for captured levels at or above the threshold. |
| `target_below_db100` | `i32` | — | Target for captured levels below the threshold. |
| `steps` | `u32` | — | Divisor of target-start; bounded1..100000. This is not milliseconds. |
| `pan` | `Option<f32>` | — | Signed stereo pan -1..1; None preserves the current balance. |
| `playback_rate` | `Option<f32>` | — | Playback multiplier0.125..4; None preserves the current rate. |
| `freeze_group_gain` | `bool` | — | Bake current native gain-group attenuation into the retired voice. Engine bus/master controls remain live. False retains the group. |
| `release_tail_when_source_missing` | `bool` | — | Without a source, release the existing tail, or complete if both absent. False rejects an absent source instead of touching the destination. |

### PixelMath

Used by: Bitmap.blit and Bitmap.stretch mode.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `copy` | — | Copy/opacity-lerp all four channels; /255 with nearest rounding. |
| `copy_rgb` | — | Copy/opacity-lerp RGB only, retaining destination alpha. |
| `copy_alpha` | — | Copy/opacity-lerp alpha only, retaining destination RGB. |
| `copy_non_transparent` | — | Copy all four channels only when the source alpha is nonzero. Alpha selects coverage; it does not become an additional blend weight. |
| `source_over` | — | Conventional straight RGBA source-over, including destination alpha. |
| `opaque_scalar256` | — | Encoded-byte scalar interpolation /256; full opacity copies RGBA, otherwise alpha is zero. No color-space conversion is performed. |
| `mask_scalar256` | — | Scalar source-alpha /256 interpolation into an opaque bitmap. Writes alpha zero even at source alpha zero; opacity zero skips the whole draw. |
| `mask_hold_alpha_scalar256` | — | MaskScalar256's RGB interpolation that keeps the destination alpha (krkr `TVPAlphaBlend_HDA`: sopa = s.a, or s.a*opacity>>8 below 255). |
| `mask_rgba_scalar256` | — | Interpolate all four stored channels by source alpha /256. |
| `mask_piecewise256` | `weight: u16` | Explicit per-mask /256 profile: mask0 skips; mask255 uses weight and 256-weight; partial masks use a=mask*weight>>8 and 255-a. RGB products are summed then shifted. Destination alpha is retained. |
| `mask_separate256` | — | Independent /256 floors for source-alpha RGB products. Mask0 skips; mask255 copies RGB. Destination alpha is retained; opacity must be255. |
| `mask_increment256` | — | Mask0 skips, mask255 copies RGB; partial weights are a+1 /255-a. The sum is shifted once by8; destination alpha is retained. |
| `ps` | `blend: PsBlend, hold_alpha: bool` | Photoshop-like blend (krkr `tvpps.c`): per channel `f(s, d)`, then d + ((f - d)·a >> 8) with a = s.a (·opacity >> 8 below 255). With `hold_alpha` the destination alpha is kept (`_HDA`), otherwise the result alpha is zero, as the native kernels write it. |
| `opaque_on_alpha_scalar256` | — | Encoded-byte scalar opaque-source blend onto straight alpha. Full opacity copies RGB and writes alpha 255; partial opacity uses the scalar opacity-on-opacity lookup table, ignoring source alpha. |
| `alpha_on_alpha_scalar256` | — | Encoded-byte scalar straight-alpha blend using the scalar lookup table. This deliberately preserves the scalar transparent-pixel quirks; it is not the SIMD or conventional /255 source-over profile. |
| `mask255` | — | Straight mask blend: truncate opacity*source_alpha/255, rounded RGB, alpha = dst_alpha + floor((255-dst_alpha)*effective_alpha/255). |
| `premultiplied_mask256` | — | Premultiplied RGB + byte mask: src + floor((256-mask)*dst/256), saturating; mask zero skips, destination alpha is retained. Only opacity=255 is supported; native fade parameters need a separate operation. |

### Fog

Used by: `Environment.fog`.

| `color` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.45,0.5,0.6]` | Linear inscattered color. |
| `density` | `f32` | `0.02` | Extinction per world unit at `base_height`. |
| `height_falloff` | `f32` | `0.2` | Exponential decay per world unit of height (0 = uniform fog). |
| `base_height` | `f32` | `0.0` | World height where `density` applies. |
| `start_distance` | `f32` | `0.0` | Distance from the camera before fog starts. |
| `max_opacity` | `f32` | `1.0` | Opacity cap (keeps distant geometry and sky partly visible). |
| `sun_scattering` | `f32` | `0.0` | Extra inscattering toward the sun (color × sun color × strength). |
| `sun_exponent` | `f32` | `8.0` | Sharpness of the inscattering lobe toward the sun (1..256). |

### ScreenSpaceReflections

Used by: `Environment.reflections` (ADR 0023).

Screen-space reflections (ADR 0023): rays marched against the depth prepass, radiance reprojected from the previous HDR frame, blended over the prefiltered environment specular by hit confidence and roughness.

|---|---|---|---|
| `intensity` | `f32` | `1.0` | Strength of the screen-space contribution (0..4). |
| `max_distance` | `f32` | `30.0` | World-space ray length (m). |
| `thickness` | `f32` | `0.3` | Depth tolerance (m) for counting a ray as behind a surface. |
| `max_roughness` | `f32` | `0.6` | Roughness at which reflections have fully faded to the environment. |
| `steps` | `u32` | `48` | Linear march steps (refined by a binary search). |
| `ray_traced` | `bool` | `false` | Trace GGX glossy rays against the scene when the renderer runs the hardware ray-tracing path (ADR 0058); screen space otherwise. The technique actually used is reported in the RT statistics. |
| `ray_samples` | `u32` | `16` | GGX rays per pixel on the hardware path (1..64); exact mirrors use one. |

### ToonShading

Used by: Material.toon.

Cel ("toon") shading, evaluated on display-referred (gamma) values like the forward toon shaders of Unity-era games:  - `c = base · base_color` (+ rim `pow(1 − n·v + rim_shift, rim_power) · rim_color`); - `u = n·l · 0.4951 + 0.5`; `a = shadow.a · (1 − rate(u))`; - `m = mix(c, shadow.rgb, a)` (+ highlight `hi.rgb · hi.a · max(n·h, 0)^highlight_power · highlight_rate`), blended toward `shadow_color` by the cast-shadow term (with `cast_shadow_ramp`, the ramp moves to its shadow end `ramp(0)` instead); - colour = `m · ramp(u) · sun + max(n·h, 0)^48 · shininess + c · ambient · ambient_scale`, with `sun` limited per channel to `light_limit` when it is positive.  `lookup_texture` (linear, 256×3) holds the diffuse ramp in row 0, the shadow-layer rate in row 1 (red) and, with `color_table`, a colour table in row 2: base, shadow, ramp and highlight colours are replaced by `table(red · 0.9951)`. `shadow_texture` and `highlight_texture` are sampled raw (no sRGB decode). Toon materials bind these three textures in place of the metallic-roughness, occlusion and specular slots, which must be empty, and take no shader effect.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lookup_texture` | `Option<T>` | `null` | — |
| `outline_texture` | `Option<T>` | `null` | Raw hull colour texture. Lookup row 2 supplies its independent lighting ramp. |
| `shadow_texture` | `Option<T>` | `null` | — |
| `highlight_texture` | `Option<T>` | `null` | — |
| `blend_texture` | `Option<T>` | `null` | Second base texture the colour moves toward by the node's `AnimationState::base_blend` weight (sampled like the base texture). |
| `liquid_blobs` | `Option<T>` | `null` | Liquid layer (with `liquid_regions`): blob masks sampled at `uv · liquid_tiling.xy + liquid_tiling.zw` — red the level-2 blobs `A`, green the level-1 blobs `B` (linear). |
| `liquid_regions` | `Option<T>` | `null` | Liquid layer region masks (RGBA, linear, uv0): region `c` at level `l` (`AnimationState::liquid_levels`, 0–2) covers `min(max(sat(l − 1)·A, l·B), region_c)`; the summed coverage (saturated) moves the base toward `liquid_color` (linear). |
| `liquid_tiling` | `[f32; 4]` | `[1.0,1.0,0.0,0.0]` | — |
| `liquid_color` | `[f32; 3]` | `[1.0,1.0,1.0]` | — |
| `color_table` | `bool` | `false` | — |
| `rim_color` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | — |
| `rim_power` | `f32` | `3.0` | — |
| `rim_shift` | `f32` | `0.0` | — |
| `shadow_color` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.5,0.5,0.5]` | Display-referred colour under cast shadows. |
| `cast_shadow_ramp` | `bool` | `false` | Cast shadows shade with the ramp's shadow tone (`ramp(0)`, relative to the surface colour) instead of the absolute `shadow_color`, and the outline is shaded like the surface (`outline · (ramp · sun + ambient · ambient_scale)`) instead of `ramp · outline · sun · 2 + ambient · 2`. |
| `ambient_scale` | `f32` | `1.0` | Scale of the environment ambient term. |
| `light_limit` | `f32` | `0.0` | Per-channel upper bound of the display-referred key light colour (× intensity) the ramp is multiplied by; 0 leaves it unbounded. |
| `shade_from_base` | `bool` | `false` | Row 0's red channel is the lit amount and the shadow tone comes from the base texture colour in linear space: its hue, saturation `√S · min(10√V, 1)` and value `0.5√V + 0.5` (HSV), i.e. the shaded colour is `base · mix(shade(base), 1, lit)` (linear). |
| `shadow_rim` | `[f32; 4]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0,0.0]` | With `shade_from_base`: the shadow tone moves toward this linear colour (rgb) at grazing angles, `min((1 − n'·v)^1.8, 1) · (0.7 − 0.2 · (clamp(lum(sun), 1, 3) − 1)) · a` with `n'` the normal bent 0.25 down. |
| `shadow_light` | `[f32; 4]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0,0.0]` | With `shade_from_base` and `a > 0`: the ILLGAMES AL skin light model. The shadow tone becomes `lum + k·(f·M − lum)` with `M` the mix of the ambient tone (`HSV(SH · 0.7 + 0.3)`, saturation × 1.5) toward the base shade by `w = (0.7 − 0.2·(clamp(lum(L), 1, 3) − 1)) · 0.375 · (1 + sat(n·l))`, `f`/`k` from the key light's per-channel `clamp(log10 L, 0, 3) + sat(L)` sum `s` (`f = 1 − (min(s, 4) − 1)/6`, `k = 1.1 + 0.9·sat((s − 1)/3)`); the result is lit by `mix(rgb, L', max(shadow, 0.5)·sat((n·l + 0.8)·0.625))`, `rgb` (linear) the light on the unlit side (toward the SH ambient as `avg(L)` exceeds 1), `L' = max(min(L, 1), 0.8·min(L, 1) + 0.2)`. |
| `shade_kind` | `ToonShadeKind` | `"base_hsv"` | The base shade `M` mixes toward under `shadow_light` (the shadow rim tint still applies to `base_hsv`). |
| `shade_color` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.5,0.5,0.5]` | Linear shade colour of `ToonShadeKind::Fixed`. |
| `shadow_tone_override` | `[f32; 4]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Linear override RGB and blend weight for the completed shadow tone, after ambient/key grading and before the light ramp. Zero weight keeps the grade. |
| `surface_line_texture` | `Option<T>` | `null` | Linear RGBA mask interpreted according to `line_model`. The default uses R as a gate and G as coverage over the lit surface. |
| `line_model` | `ToonLineModel` | `{"kind":"gated"}` | Selects the mask channels and whether the line affects alpha coverage. |
| `line_color` | `[f32; 4]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0,0.0]` | — |
| `shininess` | `f32` | `0.0` | — |
| `highlight_rate` | `f32` | `0.0` | — |
| `highlight_power` | `f32` | `1.0` | — |
| `outline_width` | `f32` | `0.0` | Inverted-hull outline: clip-space width (0 disables) and colour, lit by the ramp at `n·l`. |
| `outline_color` | `[f32; 4]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0,1.0]` | — |

### LightShape

Used by: `LightSpec.shape`.

Local light shape. Point and spot lights are punctual; a rect light is a one-sided area emitter facing the entity's -Z (spot axis convention). Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `point` | — | Omnidirectional punctual light (candela). |
| `spot` | `inner_degrees: f32, outer_degrees: f32` | Cone along local -Z with inner/outer half angles (degrees). |
| `rect` | `size: [f32; 2]` | One-sided area light of `size` [w, h], facing local -Z. |
| `directional` | — | Parallel light along local -Z confined to the range sphere (a local "light volume"); intensity is illuminance (lux), not candela. |
| `ambient` | — | Uniform diffuse irradiance inside the range sphere (an ambient volume); intensity is illuminance (lux). |

### LightUnits

Used by: `LightSpec.units`.

Photometric unit of [`LightSpec::intensity`].

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `candela` | — | Luminous intensity (lm/sr), the renderer's native unit. |
| `lumens` | — | Total luminous flux. Point and spot lights use lm / 4π (as UE does, so narrowing a cone does not brighten it); rect lights use lm / π. |

### Falloff

Used by: `LightSpec.falloff`.

Distance attenuation inside [`LightSpec::range`]. Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `inverse_square` | — | Physical 1/d² with a smooth window ending at the range. |
| `exponent` | `exponent: f32` | `(1 − d²/r²)^exponent` with no 1/d² term (UE's non-inverse-squared lights, and artist-tuned lights of older engines). Intensity is then the illuminance at the light's position. |

### ReflectionProbeSpec

Used by: `EntitySpec.reflection_probe`, `Entity.setReflectionProbe` (ADR 0024/0025).

Box-projected reflection capture (ADR 0024). The renderer captures the scene around the entity's world position into a prefiltered radiance map and uses it, parallax-corrected against the box, for glossy reflections of points inside the box (UE-style box reflection capture).

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `extent` | `[f32; 3]` | `[1.0,1.0,1.0]` | Half size of the influence/projection box (world axes, meters). |
| `intensity` | `f32` | `1.0` | Multiplier of the captured radiance (0..16). |
| `blend_distance` | `f32` | `0.5` | Distance inside the box faces over which the probe fades in. |
| `revision` | `u32` | `0` | Bump to request a recapture of an unchanged probe (e.g. after moving lights). |
| `source` | `Option<String>` | — | Authored equirect Radiance `.hdr` radiance instead of an engine capture (e.g. converted legacy cubemaps; ADR 0025). |
| `parallax` | `bool` | `true` | Box-projected (true) or infinitely distant (false) reflections. |

### IrradianceVolumeSpec

Used by: `EntitySpec.irradiance_volume`, `Entity.setIrradianceVolume` (ADR 0028).

Dynamic diffuse global illumination volume (ADR 0028): a grid of irradiance probes centred on the entity, refreshed a few per frame by rendering the lit scene around each probe. Each refresh sees the previous result, so bounces accumulate over updates.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `extent` | `[f32; 3]` | `[1.0,1.0,1.0]` | Half size of the volume (world axes, meters). |
| `counts` | `[u32; 3]` | `[8,4,8]` | Probes per axis (≥ 2 each, ≤ 4096 in total). |
| `intensity` | `f32` | `1.0` | Multiplier of the indirect diffuse light (0..16). |
| `probes_per_frame` | `u32` | `8` | Probes refreshed per frame, round-robin (1..256); each costs six capture renders. |
| `idle_probes_per_frame` | `u32` | `0` | Probes refreshed per frame once every probe has been refreshed three times and no light, static object, material override, sun or environment changed (0 = stop refreshing until something changes). |
| `visibility` | `bool` | `true` | Chebyshev visibility from per-probe distance moments against light leaking through walls (false: interpolate without occlusion). |
| `revision` | `u32` | `0` | Bump to restart accumulation. |
| `ray_traced` | `bool` | `false` | On the hardware ray-tracing path, update probes with ray queries against the scene instead of six raster face captures (ADR 0059). Ray-traced updates light hits by the sun, emission and the volume itself, including shared point/spot/rect and volume lights (ADR 0060). |

### VfxSimulationClock

Used by: `VfxSystemSpec.clock`; separate engine or explicit tick/wall-time sources.

Simulation integration and wall-time sources are independent. External ticks are counted since the current system revision started. Variants are tagged by `"source"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `engine` | — | Existing engine-delta fixed-step behavior. |
