### VfxSequenceRng

Used by: `VfxSystemSpec.sequence_rng`; explicit serializable integer stream.

Serializable integer sequence. One owner hands the stream to a worker and receives the resulting state at completion; concurrent consumers must fence. Variants are tagged by `"algorithm"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `lcg32` | `state: u32, multiplier: u32, increment: u32, output_shift: u8, output_mask: u32` | Wrapping32-bit linear congruential stream with explicit output mapping. |

### VfxSequenceExchange

Used by: `VfxSystemSpec.sequence_exchange`; fenced stream replacement acknowledged by workers.

Fenced replacement of an engine-owned shared random stream. The emitter pools are preserved; a completed receipt acknowledges this epoch.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `epoch` | `u64` | — | Strictly increasing exchange identity within a system revision. |
| `base_tick` | `u64` | — | Completed external tick at which the stream was borrowed. |
| `state` | `VfxSequenceRng` | — | State after the external consumer's own semantic random operations. |

### Paint

Used by: `LayerSpec.paint`.

Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `coverage_write` | `paint: Box<Paint>` | Draw into this client's transient coverage plane. Later ordinary draws consume its blue byte as source alpha coverage; the color target is unchanged. The inner payload must not itself be a coverage command. |
| `coverage_reset` | `value: u8` | Replace the client's coverage state with a uniform byte value. |
| `glyph_view` | `source: u32, range: Option<[usize;2]>` | A positioned-glyph source view. Geometry/filter/opacity belong to this layer; content and reveal state remain owned by the source layer. |
| `group` | `tint: [u8;4], add: [f32;3]` | Transform/opacity carrier with no raster payload. |
| `ordered_state` | `command: ordered_state::Command` | Global ordered composition command, consumed during frame extraction. |
| `solid` | `color: [u8; 4]` | Solid RGBA8 fill. |
| `image` | `asset: String, tint: [u8; 4]` | Image asset with an RGBA8 tint. |
| `text` | `text: String, font: String, size: u16, color: [u8; 4], layout: String` | Text with an explicit project font alias, pixel size, color and layout. |
| `glyph_run` | `font: String, size: f32, color: [u8; 4], bold: bool, glyphs: Vec<PositionedGlyph>, reveal: Option<GlyphReveal>, blur: Option<GlyphBlur>, outline: Option<GlyphOutline>` | Retained explicit glyph positions, rendered as independent cached glyph quads. No VM renderer or flattened text/screen image is involved. |
| `snapshot` | `size: [u32; 2], layers: Arc<Vec<LayerSpec>>` | Frozen, source-local static scene, rasterized once at `size` before the outer Layer's transform, opacity, UV crop and filter are applied. Inputs contain no nested snapshots, external parents or dynamic state. |
| `projected_mesh` | `frame: Arc<crate::projected_mesh::MeshFrame>, tint: [u8; 4]` | Immutable projected triangles drawn directly in retained order. Vertex depth and clip W survive to rasterization; no composed-screen texture. |
| `backdrop` | `history: bool` | What has been drawn beneath this layer in the current frame, read back into a quad. With a filter's distortion this is a screen effect over a depth band: layers ordered above stay untouched. Only the top-level frame has such a backdrop; inside isolated targets the layer draws nothing. With `history` it shows what the previous frame had at this depth, then captures again: drawn with an opacity below 255 that is a feedback trail. |
| `legacy_mesh` | `spec: Arc<crate::legacy_mesh::Spec>` | Logical fixed-function mesh resource. Shared frame extraction evaluates shading and projection against its real retained ancestor matrices. |
| `mesh` | `frame: Arc<crysirror_puppet::PuppetFrame>, tint: [u8; 4]` | Immutable, validated engine mesh resource. Capturing an evaluated puppet freezes its completed geometry; textures remain client-scoped immutable image dependencies, with no rig/player or device handles. |
| `puppet` | `asset: String, tint: [u8; 4]` | 2D deformable puppet (ADR 0029): an engine puppet rig JSON asset, fitted into the layer rect (aspect preserved). |

### SubtreeTransitionEffect

Used by: `LayerCommand.begin_crossfade_effect.effect`; reusable isolated subtree effects.

A scoped, renderer-owned transition between two isolated subtree inputs. Filters use encoded byte-domain pixels, edge replication and bounded radii. Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `blur` | `before: [u32; 2], after: [u32; 2], dynamic: bool` | Increasing blur of the old input and decreasing blur of the new one, followed by gamma-space byte-weight blending. Static inputs are GPU snapshots; dynamic inputs are recaptured each frame. |
| `dim` | `rule: RuleWipe, blur: [u32; 2], negative: bool, acceleration: f64` | Grayscale, clamped-edge box-blurred rule image, optionally inverted, controlling a rule wipe. Acceleration matches the legacy pow curve. |
| `glitch` | `params: GlitchParams, mode: GlitchTransition, seed: u64` | Block/line displacement with channel splitting (KiriKiri GlitchEffect `glitch`/`fadeglitch`). Each frame regenerates its field from `seed + elapsed_ms`; inputs are recaptured every frame. A `fade` transition may use its destination as its own source. |

### RuleWipe

Used by: Shared subtree rule image and soft-edge levels.

Rule-image wipe (KiriKiri `universal` transition): with phase `progress * (255 + vague)` (vague 0 is a hard edge), a pixel whose rule value is below `phase - vague` shows the new subtree, at or above `phase` the old one, and in between blends linearly.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset` | `String` | — | Grayscale rule image asset, stretched over the destination root. |
| `vague` | `u32` | — | Soft-edge width in rule levels, 1..=4096. |

### CanvasCommand

Used by: `Canvases.apply`, `ServiceBatch.canvases`.

Variants are tagged by `"op"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `create` | `id: u32, width: u32, height: u32` | Issued by `Canvases.apply`. |
| `destroy` | `id: u32` | Release one unpresented surface. Hide its presentations first. Frozen copies own their draw nodes and remain valid after the source is gone. |
| `retire` | `id: u32` | Release a source and its generated presentation draws while retaining public root layers (placement, effects and externally attached children). Frozen copies continue to own their immutable content. |
| `clear` | `id: u32, color: [u8; 4]` | Issued by `Canvases.apply`. |
| `resize` | `id: u32, width: u32, height: u32` | Change the surface size, keeping its contents anchored at the top-left; area outside previous content stays transparent. |
| `draw` | `id: u32, layer: LayerSpec, atop: Option<AtopMode>` | Append a draw; with `atop` it is drawn source-atop (see Copy). |
| `set` | `id: u32, layer: LayerSpec` | Atomically replace this surface's contents with one logical resource draw. |
| `copy` | `source: u32, destination: u32, rect: [f32; 4], position: [f32; 2], opacity: u8, replace: bool, clip: Option<[f32; 4]>, atop: Option<AtopMode>` | Issued by `Canvases.apply`. |
| `fill` | `id: u32, rect: [f32; 4], color: [u8; 4], replace: bool, keep_alpha: bool` | Fill `rect` with a solid colour; `replace` replaces the region's pixels (transparent colours included) instead of drawing over them.  `keep_alpha` sets only the colour of the region's existing content and keeps its alpha (krkr `holdAlpha` fills); `color[3]` is then ignored. |
| `fade` | `id: u32, rect: [f32; 4], opacity: u8` | Multiply the alpha of `rect`'s existing content by `opacity`/255, colour unchanged (krkr negative-opacity colorRect). The region is frozen as one isolated snapshot so overlapping draws fade as a single composite. |
| `filter` | `id: u32, rect: [f32; 4], filter: crate::layer::LayerFilter, opacity: u8` | Recolour `rect`'s existing content through a layer filter (mono, invert, bright/dark, colour mix), blended over the original by `opacity`/255 (RealLive `grpMono`/`grpInvert`/`grpLight`). The region is frozen as one isolated snapshot, like `fade`. |
| `transform_copy` | `source: u32, destination: u32, rect: [f32; 4], matrix: [f32; 6], replace: bool, clip: Option<[f32; 4]>, opacity: u8` | Copy `rect` of `source` through an affine map of source-surface coordinates (`[a, b, c, d, tx, ty]`: x' = a·x + c·y + tx, y' = b·x + d·y + ty) without skew. `replace` replaces the covered destination region; it requires an axis-aligned result. |
| `draw_subtree` | `source: u32, destination: u32` | Freeze a visible, static, normal-alpha Layer subtree as one snapshot draw. The renderer rasterizes it at its original size before later effects. `rect` is source-root-local; `position` and `clip` are destination-space. The region is replaced, including alpha. Root placement/visibility/opacity and inheritance from outside the subtree do not enter the snapshot. Append an immutable subtree using its own placement, transform, group opacity and visibility. Outside ancestry is excluded; source pixels are composed over existing destination content instead of replacing it. |
| `copy_subtree` | `source: u32, destination: u32, rect: [f32; 4], position: [f32; 2], clip: Option<[f32; 4]>` | Issued by `Canvases.apply`. |
| `restore` | `id: u32, surface: CanvasSurface` | Replace (or create) a surface with a previously queried state (`EngineQuery::Canvas`), e.g. a native game's saved DCs. |
| `present` | `id: u32, layer: u32, order: i32, parent: Option<u32>, position: [f32; 2]` | Issued by `Canvases.apply`. |
| `present_isolated` | `id: u32, layer: u32, order: i32, parent: Option<u32>, position: [f32; 2]` | Keep the surface as one isolated snapshot draw. Source edits rebuild its immutable paint automatically; the outer parent transform/opacity applies after composition, not independently to every source draw. |
| `present_target` | `id: u32, layer: u32, order: i32, parent: Option<u32>, position: [f32; 2]` | Compose the whole surface into one bounded render target, including surfaces backed by storage pages. Global masks/distortion sample that target once rather than independently sampling each storage tile. Dimensions must not exceed 8192; renderer memory/device budgets apply. |
| `hide` | `layer: u32` | Issued by `Canvases.apply`. |

### LayerFilter

Used by: `Layers.setFilter` (ADR 0021).

Per-layer 2D filter stack with the stage order and parameter meaning of the Siglus/tona3 sprite effect (ADR 0021). Color math runs on 8-bit gamma-encoded values like the original: distortion sampling → tint/alpha → tone curve → invert → mono → bright → dark → color rate → add → mask → gray-as-alpha → alpha test.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `multiply` | `[f32; 3]` | `[1.0,1.0,1.0]` | Gamma-space RGB modulation before the effect stack, preserving alpha. Works for retained snapshots and other paints without image tint slots. |
| `luma_weights` | `Option<[f32; 3]>` | `null` | Optional normalized RGB luminance coefficients. None preserves the established filter profile; adapters may declare a native color model. |
| `rgb_alpha_power` | `f32` | `0.0` | Multiply filtered RGB by sampled alpha raised to this power (0..4), independently of the blend mode and without replacing stored alpha. |
| `ignore_tint_alpha` | `bool` | `false` | Sampling effects may preserve source alpha without applying vertex tint alpha. Parent transform/clip ownership remains unchanged. |
| `encoded_sampling` | `bool` | `false` | Interpolate gamma-encoded RGB texels before color effects. This matches raster APIs whose texture sampler does not decode sRGB before filtering. |
| `mono` | `f32` | `0.0` | Mix toward grayscale (0..1). |
| `invert` | `f32` | `0.0` | Mix toward the inverted color (0..1). |
| `bright` | `f32` | `0.0` | Mix toward white (0..1). |
| `dark` | `f32` | `0.0` | Mix toward black (0..1). |
| `color_rate` | `f32` | `0.0` | Mix toward `color` (0..1). |
| `color` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Target color of `color_rate` (0..1 per channel). |
| `add` | `[f32; 3]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Signed per-channel addition (-1..1). |
| `tone_curve` | `Option<ToneCurve>` | `null` | Tone-curve LUT lookup, or `null`. |
| `mask` | `Option<LayerMask>` | `null` | Grayscale mask image multiplied into alpha, or `null`. |
| `stencil` | `Option<LayerStencil>` | — | An independent canvas-space red-channel matte, multiplied into source alpha after colour effects and continuous rule-image coverage. |
| `alpha_test` | `bool` | `false` | Discard pixels whose alpha is below 1/255. |
| `distortion` | `Option<Distortion>` | `null` | Source-sampling distortion, or `null`. |

### Blend

Used by: `LayerSpec.blend`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `normal` | — | Source-over alpha blending. |
| `add` | — | Additive. |
| `subtract` | — | Subtractive. |
| `multiply` | — | Multiply. |
| `screen` | — | Screen. |
| `atop` | — | Source-atop: drawn only where the destination has alpha, which it keeps (KiriKiri holdAlpha draws). Meaningful in isolated canvas snapshots, where the destination is the surface's own content. |
| `atop_multiply` | — | Photoshop multiply keeping the destination alpha (KiriKiri omPsMultiplicative with holdAlpha): D·(1 - a + a·S). |
| `atop_screen` | — | Photoshop screen keeping the destination alpha (omPsScreen with holdAlpha): D·(1 - a·S) + a·S·Da. |
| `atop_copy` | — | Replace the colour and keep the destination alpha (KiriKiri copyRect on dfOpaque with holdAlpha, TVP_BB_COPY_MAIN): straight S·Da. |
| `source_over` | — | Fixed-function (ONE, INVSRCALPHA) on straight texels: S + D·(1 - Sa), every channel including alpha. |
| `modulate` | — | (ZERO, SRCCOLOR): D·S on every channel, alpha ignored as a weight. |
| `inverse_destination` | — | (INVDESTCOLOR, ZERO): S·(1 - D) on every channel. |
| `modulate_add` | — | (DESTCOLOR, ONE): S·D + D on every channel. |
| `destination_in` | — | Keep the destination only under the source alpha: D·Sa, including alpha. Source RGB is ignored; use inside an isolated Canvas for masks. |
| `stored_byte` | `mode: crysirror_image::rgb_lut::ConstantByteBlend, force_source_opaque: bool, force_output_opaque: bool` | Destination-reading stored-byte blend. Uses shared integer colour kernels in gamma-encoded RGB and /128 RGB tint quantization. The mode defines coverage and output alpha: legacy modes retain destination alpha; Scalar256 writes its effective source coverage. The flags may explicitly normalize an opaque source or an XRGB output target. |

### ToneCurve

Used by: `LayerFilter.tone_curve`.

Tone-curve lookup: each channel indexes column `value` of `row` in a LUT image (e.g. 256×N), after mixing `saturation` toward mono.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset` | `String` | — | LUT image asset. |
| `row` | `f32` | — | LUT row to sample. |
| `saturation` | `f32` | — | Mix toward mono before the lookup (0..1). |

### LayerMask

Used by: `LayerFilter.mask`.

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `asset` | `String` | — | Grayscale mask image asset. |
| `gray_alpha` | `bool` | — | Replace alpha with the final gray level (Siglus mask mode 1). |
| `channel` | `MaskChannel` | — | Rgba multiplies all source channels. Selecting one encoded mask byte replaces source alpha with clamp(trunc(byte*scale+offset),0,255)/255, applied per texel before linear interpolation. |
| `offset` | `f32` | — | — |
| `scale` | `f32` | — | Signed multiplier of the selected encoded byte, before `offset` and saturation. Negative values implement inverted rule-image wipes. |
| `preserve_source_alpha` | `bool` | — | Multiply the selected mask byte by each original source alpha byte. |
| `source_space` | `bool` | — | Address mask pixels in source-image coordinates; outside pixels keep their original alpha instead of stretching or clamping the mask. |
| `coverage` | `Option<MaskCoverage>` | — | Continuous coverage computed after interpolating mask bytes. None keeps the existing per-texel integer mask profile unchanged. |

### Distortion

Used by: `LayerFilter.distortion`.

Source-sampling effects (Siglus wipe modes 1–6), in texture UV space. Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `nine_tap` | `offset: [f32; 2], center_weight: f32, neighbor_weight: f32` | Nine clamped taps: one center and eight surrounding samples at ±offset. Weights are explicit, without implicit normalization or alpha replacement. |
| `quantized` | `steps: [f32; 2], phase: [f32; 2]` | Quantize UV independently per axis: floor(uv*steps+phase)/steps. Source alpha is preserved, including transparent atlas padding. |
| `mosaic` | `cut: f32, aspect: f32` | Cells of `cut` UV width; height = cut × `aspect`. |
| `raster` | `vertical: bool, fractions: f32, waves: f32, power: f32, progress: f32` | Sinusoidal row (`vertical: false`) or column offset driven by `progress`. |
| `radial_blur` | `center: [f32; 2], power: f32, coeff: f32` | Radial blur toward `center` (UV), 10 weighted taps. |
| `wave` | `vertical: bool, amplitude: f32, cycles: f32, phase: f32` | Rows (or columns when `vertical`) shifted by amplitude·sin(2π(cycles·t + phase)), all in UV. |
| `threshold_fade` | `fade: f32, threshold: f32, invert: bool` | Multiply alpha by `fade` where luminance ≤ `threshold` (or ≥ when `invert`). |

### TransitionSpec

Used by: `Layers.transition` (ADR 0022).

Full-screen transition from the engine's previously presented scene to the current one. Named engine effects have explicit contracts; the `Siglus` variant separately preserves its native WIPE table (ADR 0022).

| Field | Rust type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `effect` | `TransitionEffect` | — | Transition effect. |
| `duration_ms` | `u64` | — | Duration in milliseconds. A hard byte rule with a stationary threshold accepts u64::MAX to hold a caller-updated mask until EndTransition. |
| `easing` | `Easing` | — | Progress curve (Siglus speed modes 0-3). |

### TransitionEffect

Used by: `TransitionSpec.effect`.

Variants are tagged by `"kind"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `crossfade` | — | Plain cross-dissolve. |
| `mask` | `asset: String, fade: u8, vague: Option<u16>` | Grayscale mask image: bright pixels reveal first; `fade` 0..=8 is the Siglus soft-edge step (0 = hard edge). |
| `byte_rule` | `asset: String, invert: bool, soft: bool, numerator: u32, denominator: u32, step_ms: u32` | An integer-clock reveal over an 8-bit grayscale rule. In hard mode a pixel is replaced when its rule is at or below the current phase. Soft mode uses (rule + phase - 256), clamped to a byte, as a /256 blend weight over stored color bytes. |
| `pixel_stretch` | `canvas: [u32; 2], axes: [bool; 2], shrink_outgoing: bool, numerator: u32, denominator: u32, step_ms: u32` | Stretch scene pixels into a top-left rectangle at discrete clock steps. |
| `slide` | `direction: u8` | direction 0 down, 1 up, 2 right, 3 left (Siglus type 200, both scenes move). |
| `mosaic` | `size: u32` | Mosaic out of the old scene and into the new one (type 230). |
| `spin_zoom` | `reverse: bool` | The new scene grows from the canvas centre (scale 0→1) while turning one revolution, counter-clockwise or `reverse`d, over the old scene (N-System CDIBOverlap Rotate, DrawRotate 0x42BC50). |
| `bounce` | `count: u16, vector: [i16; 2], damped: bool, stretch: bool` | The new scene offset along `vector` (px) by a triangle wave of `count` round trips, uncovered pixels keeping the old scene; `damped` scales the offset by 1 − t/2; `stretch` grows the scene by the offset about its centre instead of moving it (N-System Bound, DrawBound 0x42CA60, modes 0/1 and +10). |
| `door_flip` | `axis: u8, focal: u16` | A perspective page flip over black: the old scene turns away about `axis` (0 vertical, 1 horizontal, 2 the view axis) through a quarter turn, then the new scene turns in; `focal` is the pinhole distance in px (N-System RotDoor, MoveRotDoor 0x42E000). |
| `ordered_dither` | `cell: [u32; 2], diagonal: bool, steps: u32` | Ordered Bayer-4 fade in logical canvas pixels. This is a shared engine effect with an independent code, not an alias for a Siglus wipe type. |
| `siglus` | `code: i32, options: Vec<i32>, mask: Option<String>` | A raw Siglus wipe type with its option list. Pattern types (5..=199) without `mask` use the original generated masks. |

### LayerCommand

Used by: Layer mutation batches (`ServiceBatch.layers`).

Variants are tagged by `"op"`.

| Variant | Fields | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `create_render_target` | `id: u32, spec: render_target::RenderTargetSpec, reset_view: bool` | Allocate or replace mutable backing for an existing owned drawable. |
| `set_output` | `id: u32, target: Option<u32>` | Redirect this drawable into a retained target; None restores the frame. |
| `set_pose_copies` | `id: u32, copies: Option<Arc<pose_copies::PoseCopies>>` | Replace bitmap geometry instances without replacing image, pose tracks, source crop, camera or target ownership. None removes all instances. |
| `advance_time` | `delta_ms: u64` | Advance this client's automatic motion, reveal and transition clocks. Other clients, physical input, external producers and global time stay on their own clocks. Bounded to one day per admitted operation. |
| `set_clock_paused` | `id: u32, paused: bool` | Pause/resume a retained subtree without cancelling its clock state. |
| `rebind_image` | `from: String, to: String` | Atomically retarget every live owned Image paint using one immutable generation. Frozen Snapshot paints and other clients retain their leases. |
| `begin_sequence` | `id: u32, spec: LayerSequenceSpec` | Create an owner-scoped incremental channel sequence on an existing node. |
| `sequence` | `id: u32, operation: LayerSequenceOperation` | Mutate or advance retained banked queues; Advance uses exact receipts. |
| `begin_external_motion` | `id: u32, driver: u32` | Register an external procedural producer; query MotionStatus for its fresh generation before admitting worker samples. No code is hosted. |
| `commit_external_motion` | `id: u32, driver: u32, stamp: ExternalMotionStamp, complete: bool, pose: Option<ExternalMotionPose>` | Publish one consecutive producer revision. Pose changes can share this atomic Layer batch; stale results roll back every operation in the batch. |
| `request_external_motion_skip` | `id: u32, driver: u32, generation: u64` | Request the real producer's skip branch, without fabricating an endpoint. |
| `remove_external_motion` | `id: u32, driver: u32, generation: u64` | Retire the producer capability, invalidating outstanding worker samples. |
| `set_rect` | `id: u32, rect: [f32; 4]` | Change rectangle geometry while preserving other motion/producer state. |
| `set_depth` | `id: u32, depth: Option<f32>` | Stable finite floating depth within order major buckets; inherited by descendants. None returns this node to ordinary ordering in its scope. |
| `begin_motion` | `id: u32, track: MotionTrackSpec` | Start or replace one local scalar track on an owned layer. |
| `set_motion_elapsed` | `id: u32, property: MotionProperty, elapsed: u64` | Advance an external track in its caller-declared clock units. |
| `end_motion` | `id: u32, property: Option<MotionProperty>, finish: bool` | Cancel selected/all tracks, optionally applying their final values. |
| `set_solid_color` | `id: u32, color: [u8; 4]` | Change an existing Solid paint without replacing its layer or cancelling unrelated motion. Other paint kinds fail explicitly. |
| `set_paint` | `id: u32, paint: Paint` | Replace paint while retaining layer geometry and motion/sequence state. Non-image paints clear image-only sampling and UV crop state. |
| `put` | `layer: LayerSpec` | Issued by `Layers.put`. |
| `remove` | `id: u32` | Issued by `Layers.remove`. |
| `set_parent` | `id: u32, parent: Option<u32>` | Reparent an owned node without cancelling its retained motion or paint. |
| `set_transform` | `id: u32, transform: SpriteTransform` | Issued by `Layers.setTransform`. |
| `set_visible` | `id: u32, visible: bool` | Issued by `Layers.setVisible`. |
| `complete_reveal` | `id: u32` | Complete a positioned text run through the engine clock/state service. |
| `set_opacity` | `id: u32, opacity: u8` | Issued by `Layers.setOpacity`. |
| `set_blend` | `id: u32, blend: Blend` | Change composition without replacing paint, hierarchy or motion. |
| `set_order` | `id: u32, order: [i32; 2]` | Issued by `Layers.setOrder`. |
| `set_clip` | `id: u32, clip: Option<[f32; 4]>` | Issued by `Layers.setClip`. |
| `set_viewport_clip` | `id: u32, clip: Option<[f32; 4]>` | Set an inherited render-target clip, preserving geometry and motion. |
| `set_source_crop` | `id: u32, crop: Option<[f32; 4]>` | Change own source geometry/UV crop without touching children or motion. |
| `set_glyph_crops` | `id: u32, crops: Vec<Option<[f32;4]>>` | Update positioned-glyph clips without replacing paint or canceling motion. |

## JavaScript/TypeScript asynchronous helpers

These bindings return CancellablePromise values over the same bounded service jobs. Each Promise captures its initiating client and restore generation; continuations run on the script owner during lifecycle polling. `cancel()` releases pending work; atomic writes already committed cannot be undone. Image/asset/decode helpers return retained tickets that callers release after use. Save.loadAsync commits its prepared result at an owner safepoint.

| Helper | Parameters | Returns | Native start |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Bitmap.rowCopyAsync` | `slot: number, source: number, options: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<string>` | `beginRowCopy` |
| `Bitmap.transitionAsync` | `slot: number, other: number, options: Record<string, any>, mask: number \| null` | `CancellablePromise<string>` | `beginTransition` |
| `Bitmap.applyEffectAsync` | `slot: number, effects: Record<string, any>[]` | `CancellablePromise<string>` | `beginEffect` |
| `Audio.prepareSourceAsync` | `asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginPrepareSource` |
| `Audio.playSourceAsync` | `resource: Record<string, any>, voice: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginPlaySource` |
| `Audio.playSfxAsync` | `voice: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginPlaySfx` |
| `Audio.preloadSfxAsync` | `asset: string` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginPreloadSfx` |
| `Audio.playMusicAsync` | `name: string, voice: Record<string, any>, crossfade_ms: number` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginPlayMusic` |
| `Audio.seekVoiceAsync` | `handle: Record<string, any>, source_frame: number` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginSeekVoice` |
| `Audio.traceReflectionsAsync` | `query: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginReflectionProbe` |
| `Audio.prepareVoiceReflectionsAsync` | `handle: Record<string, any>, options: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginVoiceReflections` |
| `Audio.prepareReverbAsync` | `settings: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginReverb` |
| `Audio.prepareHrtfAsync` | `asset: string, options: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginHrtf` |
| `Audio.prepareAcousticsAsync` | `asset: string` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginAcousticScene` |
| `Audio.updateAcousticsAsync` | `updates: Record<string, any>[]` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginUpdateAcousticScene` |
| `Audio.traceAcousticsAsync` | `query: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginAcousticProbe` |
| `Assets.loadAsync` | `path: string, kind: string` | `CancellablePromise<number>` | `load` |
| `Resources.decodeAsync` | `asset: string, kind: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null` | `CancellablePromise<number>` | `beginDecode` |
| `Resources.imageAsync` | `asset: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null` | `CancellablePromise<number>` | `beginImage` |
| `Resources.probeAsync` | `asset: string, kind: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginProbe` |
| `Text.drawAsync` | `name: string, markup: string, options: Record<string, any> \| null` | `CancellablePromise<string>` | `beginDraw` |
| `Text.restoreAsync` | `name: string, state: Record<string, any>` | `CancellablePromise<string>` | `beginRestore` |
| `Text.measureAsync` | `font: string, size: number, text: string` | `CancellablePromise<Record<string, any>>` | `beginMeasure` |
